_about: Still cameras for meshy_village_look.py --views-file: name -> [[eye x, eye y, eye height], [target x, target y, target z], lens mm, options]. x and y are corner tile units (the look's tile_xy: a tile's centre is +0.5), the eye height is above HM_Ground (absolute world z from 25 m up), the target z is world z. Options: cut_z cuts the cave rock away above that height (P_cut_z), hide hides the named objects from the camera for that view (their shadows stay; a fog or haze volume is left out of the render); show lists objects (or collections) the build leaves out of the render, shown for that still only (the cutaway's fill light; HM_Cutaway, the cutaway's hill, land, dressing and moon); exposure adds stops for that still (the look's ink floor is scaled so black stays ink).
